flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (cronservice): workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper} (reminder query RD1-DR3, refreshContactInfo, validateContactInfo), schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, workflows/furnish_processing/helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper (hirer contact from furnish), cron-schedules-prod.properties. Other repos: no code specific to this story.
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark mentions Vault and code split. The same eNotification job handles ENA and the reminders after the letters. For notices whose last_processing_stage is RR3 (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3 are in one query) and that are close to the due date, the job prepares contacts: the DataHive refresh (Singpass for individuals, CorpPass for companies) only runs when cron.enareminder.datahive = true, but it is false in dev, UAT and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), so the mobile/email stored in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver is used (for a hirer: from the furnish form, FurnishApprovalHelper.java:556-558). The job is also switched off (cron.notification.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:236; OCMS-DF-2026-180 waits for the eNotification cron to be activated). The reminder query joins ocms_parameter ENOTEDAYS/POS/PDD for code RR3; whether the RR3 rows exist in the DB cannot verify from repo, and without them RR3 notices are not selected. The DOS source and Vault cannot verify from repo. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ was not used as evidence.
recommendation: Claim partially. Reminder selection after RR3 and contact validation exist, but the mobile/email refresh from DataHive is switched off in every environment (flag false) and the eNotification job is inactive in prod. Ask URA to confirm the DOS source and the activation schedule.

steps.step: After the 3rd letter (RR3) is sent, OCMS selects the hirer notices that need an electronic reminder
steps.detail: queryRecordsForReminder selects VONs with last_processing_stage IN ('RD1','RD2','RR3','DN1','DN2','DR3') whose due date (last_processing_date + POS + PDD) is within the ENOTEDAYS window, offender_indicator = 'Y', not in the exclusion list, not yet sent a reminder for the same stage, and not suspended except HST (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1076-1162). The job gives the stage from last_processing_stage to the record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:162-180). Partial because the query INNER JOINs an ENOTEDAYS row per stage (whether the RR3 row exists cannot verify from repo; retryDays is read from the RD1 row, 1078) and the job is inactive: cron.notification.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236, NotificationJobsScheduler.java:48-53). The query does not separate hirers from owners.

steps.step: OCMS checks the latest mobile number (individual) / email (company) from the data source (Epic OCMS9) and updates it
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and refreshContactInfo for every record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:183-188). refreshContactInfo only queries DataHive when cron.enareminder.datahive = 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2461-2485); otherwise it uses the stored number and only normalises the mobile of individuals. The flag is false in dev, UAT and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48). The active path exists: a company is looked up in the CorpPass view by UEN (CP_ACCOUNT_EMAIL, account A01 ACTIVE, 2496-2530) and an individual in the Singpass view (2710-). The stored hirer contact comes from the furnish form (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:554-558). The story says DOS; DataHive = DOS cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Notices with invalid contact details (individual without mobile, company without email) get no reminder
steps.detail: validateContactInfo rejects records with a contactError, an individual without phoneNo, and a company (id_type B) without email (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2290). In the job, failed records are skipped from the SMS batch (non-ENA stages only log 'Skipping record with invalid contact', NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:252-266), and sendEmail also refuses an empty email (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:556-566). The job is inactive in prod, but the validation logic matches the story text; same assessment as OCMS11.8.

steps.step: The check result is used for an electronic reminder that refers to the 3rd letter reminder (RR3)
steps.detail: For reminders, the record nextProcessingStage is set to last_processing_stage (RR3), so determineTemplateName yields RR3_SMS_INDIVIDUAL or RR3_EMAIL_COMPANY (plus _COMBINED) (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:174-180; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:459-476). The template data holds noticeNo, combinedNotices, amountPayable and a paymentDueDate calculated from the letter date (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:410-437, 1076-1100). The template text lives in ocms_template_store (DB), not seeded in the repo, so whether the wording refers to the 3rd letter cannot verify from repo; a missing template makes the message skipped (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:303-312). Sending the messages is assessed in OCMS11.44 and OCMS11.45.
